description: Read this token's live limits: the max order size and daily limit (USD notional: quantity x limit price, or quantity x trigger price when that is higher, or on a sell quantity x current bid when that is higher) your user set for this token, the account caps that cover every agent token on the account together (the hard outer limit once set; account.set is false when your user has not set them, and then the token's own caps alone apply), any tighter limits your user set for one exchange or one symbol on it (venue_caps, with today's use there), the most live orders this token may place in any rolling minute (max_orders_per_minute; null = no rate limit), how much of each is used today, and whether this token can place a live entry order right now. Read-only: an agent cannot set or raise these; only the user can, at /account/tokens/ (set_at). The day is the UTC calendar day (resets_at). Returns { live, max_order_usd, daily_limit_usd, used_today_usd, remaining_today_usd, account: { set, max_order_usd, daily_limit_usd, used_today_usd, remaining_today_usd }, effective_max_order_usd, effective_remaining_today_usd, venue_caps, max_orders_per_minute, agent_trading_paused, paused_at, token_paused, token_paused_at, day, resets_at, unit, set_at, can_place_live, code?, reason? }. agent_trading_paused true means your user has paused all agent trading on the account (code agent_trading_paused); only your user can turn it off. token_paused true means your user has paused this token (code agent_token_paused); only your user can turn it off. Tell your user these numbers before going live. Requires your Autoview account token.

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).
